invariants.title: Consultation slot cannot have two active bookings
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Row-level locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE) on slot and DB uniqueness constraint on Consultation.slot_id
invariants.bypass_paths: None identified in production code; concurrent booking prevented by DB row locks

invariants.title: Payment cannot be refunded twice
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Sums prior RefundRecord rows and checks remaining_refundable <= 0 or status == REFUNDED, raising AppException(TRANSACTION_ALREADY_REFUNDED)
invariants.bypass_paths: None in commercial_service; row lock ensures atomic refund sum check

invariants.title: Completed consultation cannot be rescheduled
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Explicit check: if consultation.status in (COMPLETED, CANCELLED, REJECTED) raises ValidationError

invariants.title: Cancelled consultation cannot be completed
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Validation check rejects if status == CANCELLED. (Note: BL-FIND-04 demonstrates reverse mutation where COMPLETED is reverted to CANCELLED via refund).

invariants.title: Closed case cannot receive ordinary modifications
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Enforced for tasks and deadlines, but NOT enforced in CaseService.update_case (title, description), add_participant, remove_participant, or create_note
invariants.test_reference: tests/integration/test_case_operations_and_workflow.py (missing negative tests for closed case note/participant mutations)

invariants.title: Deleted document cannot be treated as active
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Global filter on Document.deleted_at.is_(None) in standard retrieval methods. (Subject to DB-FIND-02 soft-delete leakage in raw queries).
invariants.bypass_paths: Raw SQL or un-scoped queries identified in Phase 2 DB-FIND-02

invariants.title: Evidence hash cannot change after evidence creation
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: sha256_hash stored on immutable EvidenceVersion entity; updates require creating a new EvidenceVersion with a new SHA256
invariants.bypass_paths: None in application layer; hash cannot be updated in-place via API

invariants.title: Evidence chain-of-custody order cannot be corrupted
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Custody events appended sequentially with UUIDv7 (time-ordered) and UTC timestamp

invariants.title: Lawyer cannot be treated as verified before verification succeeds
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: grant_lawyer_access checks lawyer_profile.verification_status == 'APPROVED', BUT add_participant completely omits verification checks (BL-FIND-01)
invariants.bypass_paths: POST /api/v1/cases/{case_id}/participants allows adding any unverified lawyer as LAWYER participant
invariants.test_reference: tests/integration/test_case_management_v2.py (missing negative tests for unverified lawyer participant addition)

invariants.title: Expired availability slot cannot be booked
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Validates slot.start_time > datetime.now(UTC) before permitting reservation

invariants.title: Invoice total must equal item totals plus taxes minus discounts
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Calculates subtotal = sum(items), tax_amount, total = subtotal + tax - discount using quantized Decimals

invariants.title: Payment amount must correspond to invoice/consultation rules
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Authoritative consultation fee retrieved from lawyer_profile.consultation_fee; client cannot supply arbitrary price

invariants.title: Refund cannot exceed captured amount
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: remaining_refundable = txn.gross_amount - prior_refunds. If target_amount > remaining_refundable raises REFUND_EXCEEDS_CAPTURED_AMOUNT

invariants.title: Message sender must be a valid participant where required
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Case messages validate participation; HOWEVER, direct messaging endpoint automatically injects sender/recipient as CaseParticipant with ACTIVE status without authorization (BL-FIND-05)
invariants.bypass_paths: POST /api/v1/messages (DM endpoint auto-enrolls users into cases)

invariants.title: AI citation must correspond to retrieved source material
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Citations are mapped to retrieved document chunks, verifying chunk existence and document_id

invariants.title: Document version must belong to the correct document
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Foreign key DocumentVersion.document_id -> documents.id; document processor queries by compound key

invariants.title: Evidence must belong to the correct case
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Evidence.case_id foreign key constraint and storage path enforcement 'cases/{case_id}/evidence/{evidence_id}'
invariants.bypass_paths: Parent case status check missing (BL-FIND-02), but case binding itself is enforced

invariants.title: Consultation participants must be consistent with consultation ownership
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Verifies actor is either client (user.id == consultation.client.user_id), assigned lawyer (user.id == consultation.lawyer.user_id), or admin

invariants.title: Case participant roles must be valid and conform to user account role
invariants.enforcement_mechanism: Validates ParticipantRole enum and ensures LAWYER participant role can only be assigned to users with UserRole.LAWYER
invariants.bypass_paths: Verification status check missing (BL-FIND-01), but role type itself is validated
